name: Callender-Events
description: ( In Development ) CaliBridge is a modern event calendar built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It supports adding and viewing events, dynamic month switching, LocalStorage sync, and clean UI animations. Designed for smooth scheduling with responsive layout, instant updates, and an intuitive experience across all devices.

paragraphs: A fast, private calendar that lives entirely in your browser.
No account, no server, no tracking. Installable and works offline.
features: Month, week and agenda views, with a live now-line, overlapping events laid out side by side, and "+N more" overflow.
Real time zones. Events are stored as exact instants plus the zone they were created in, so a 9:00 call in Tokyo shows up at the right time wherever you open it.

Repeating events (daily / weekly / monthly / yearly, every N, on chosen weekdays, until a date or a count) that stay at the same wall-clock time across daylight-saving changes. Edit, move or delete just one occurrence…
All-day and multi-day events, categories with colour filters, location and notes.
Reminders (at start, minutes, hours, days, weeks) as in-app alerts and system notifications while the app is open.

whatItDoes.text: A fast, private calendar that lives entirely in your browser.

requirements.text: No account, no server, no tracking.
